changelog: **Safeguarding — contact-detail and keyword detection, and message retention (#2056):** every message write path (composer, edits, the mentor's in-app e-mail, inbound mail replies) runs `scanMessageForSafeguarding` (`src/lib/safeguardingScan.ts`) after the row is written. The pure rule in `src/lib/safeguarding.ts` detects dialled-looking phone numbers (9–15 digits starting `+`/`00`/`0`, or the US shape), spelled-out numbers (7+ digit words, EN/TR/DE), plain and obfuscated e-mail addresses (`at`/`dot`, `[at]`, `(at)`, `ät`/`punkt`, `nokta`) and the org's watch keywords (whole-word, case/accent/Turkish-i/ß folded); dates, amounts, bare order numbers and IBAN/reference fragments are pinned negative in an EN/TR/DE corpus test. Detection never blocks or holds a message. Findings become `SafeguardingFlag` rows (new model, `orgId` + `TENANT_MODELS`, unique per message/kind/term, storing a MASKED contact detail), and the org's admins get one in-app `safeguarding.flagged` bell per hour. `/admin/safeguarding` (ADMIN-only, tenant-scoped at the route) lists flags with live context and records NO_ACTION / REVIEWED / ESCALATED (audited as `safeguarding.reviewed`), and edits the watch list and `messageRetentionDays` (new per-org settings `safeguardingKeywords`, `messageRetentionDays`, default 0 = keep forever). Retention is one `message` entry in the #1678 registry that masks bodies past the window with the delete-for-everyone mechanism (attachments dropped, body emptied, `deletedForEveryoneAt` stamped), per sender org, floor 30 days. Account erasure deletes the flags on the person's messages; the DB sanitizer drops all flags. Docs: `docs/safeguarding.md`, linked from the trust security overview.

en: Safeguarding for programme admins: private messages that share a phone number or an e-mail address, or use one of your watch keywords, appear in a review queue — without ever being blocked.
Programmes can now choose how long message text is kept; older text is removed every night and the conversation stays intact.
tr: Program yöneticileri için koruma: telefon numarası ya da e-posta adresi paylaşılan veya izleme listenizdeki bir kelimeyi içeren özel mesajlar bir inceleme listesinde görünür — hiçbir zaman engellenmeden.
Programlar artık mesaj metinlerinin ne kadar süre saklanacağını seçebiliyor; daha eski metinler her gece kaldırılır, konuşmanın kendisi bozulmaz.
de: Safeguarding für Programmverantwortliche: Private Nachrichten, in denen eine Telefonnummer oder E-Mail-Adresse geteilt oder eines Ihrer Beobachtungswörter verwendet wird, erscheinen in einer Prüfliste — ohne jemals blockiert zu werden.
Programme können jetzt festlegen, wie lange Nachrichtentext aufbewahrt wird; älterer Text wird jede Nacht entfernt, die Unterhaltung bleibt erhalten.
